cards.mood: The piece opens with a solitary, contemplative mood established by a lone acoustic instrument, evoking a sense of isolation.
cards.palette: An acoustic guitar with a resonant, slightly percussive strumming pattern serves as the harmonic backbone, present from the very beginning and continuing through to the end.

lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Gray clouds gather on the harbor line
Salt air stings the weathered pine
Sitting on the porch in the shade
Watching the colors of the evening fade
[Pre-Chorus]
The tide pulls back the heavy deep
Secrets that the rolling waters keep
[Chorus]
Oh, the moon is a silver ghost
Watching the things I love the most
A restless heart in a steady hand
Searching for home in the shifting sand
[Verse]
The lighthouse beams a steady eye
Underneath the bruised and heavy sky
Footprints fade along the sandy shore
I don't walk these paths any more
[Pre-Chorus]
The wind whispers secrets through the grass
Watching the lonely seasons pass
[Chorus]
Oh, the moon is a silver ghost
Watching the things I love the most
A restless heart in a steady hand
Searching for home in the shifting sand
[Instrumental]
[Bridge]
The road is long and the night is wide
Nowhere left for a weary soul to hide
[Chorus]
Oh, the moon is a silver ghost
Watching the things I love the most
A restless heart in a steady hand
Searching for home in the shifting sand
[Outro]
